title: Keyboard shortcuts
intro: <k/> uses Ctrl on Windows/Linux and ⌘ on Mac. Dimmed rows arrive in a later build phase.

desc.moveRows: Move through rows (PgUp, PgDn, Home, End too)
desc.openRow: Open row: stock movement (Inventory), edit (Parties), view & print (Register)
desc.newRecord: New item, party or voucher (also from Home)
desc.billEnter: Select item, then Qty → Rate → Disc → next row
desc.billMove: Same column, previous / next row (in the item picker: move highlight)
desc.quickAdd: Quick-add a new item (also works inside the item picker)
desc.clearItem: On a chosen item cell: clear it and pick a different item
desc.removeLine: Remove line (Delete on a chosen item cell, Alt+Delete from any cell of the row)
desc.billDiscount: Jump to bill discount (5% or an amount)
desc.savePreview: Save & preview print (Ctrl+W is best effort, see browser limits)
desc.billEscape: Close an open picker, otherwise discard voucher (asks first)
